reason: Concrete implementation review exposed UniformRange cancellation-of-scale precision and unmeasurable callable-copy storage; settle exact behavior before first execution. Generic guarded display publication supplies an existing Auto prerequisite without a new Document revision.

decisions.scope: UniformRange only; ProcessorRaw exact source operation order unchanged
decisions.membership: Exact low endpoint maps bin0; exact high endpoint maps final bin. Interior values use half-open intervals of the actual finite nondecreasing rounded edges; equality chooses the rightmost repeated interior edge. Duplicate zero-width interior intervals are empty. Lower/upper endpoint exceptions remain explicit even if their rounded edge is repeated.
decisions.implementation_bound: Use bounded binary search of at most65537edges, or a normalized candidate validated against edges followed by binary-search correction. No unbounded per-sample walk.
decisions.reason: Overflow-safe scaled normalization alone rounds all three fractions to0.5, losing their actual side of the central edge. Edge-consistent comparison preserves a meaningful uniform partition without overflow.

decisions.included: ExecutionControl/callable holder objects and every introspectable capture/request/selection/metadata/calibration/array/mask/raster scratch byte remain charged under the unchanged working limit.
decisions.excluded: Opaque std::function target-copy internals are not measurable by the standard API. Later Python getter/representation copies and externally retained user callback objects are outside this native estimate, as are existing external source caches, allocator bookkeeping, GPU/history/processRSS.
decisions.rule: Freeze callable owners by value before callbacks for lifetime/reentry correctness. State exclusions in public estimate and binding documentation; do not claim a total allocation/process cap or introspect concrete callable types. No new callback framework.

decisions.semantics: Document checks exact owner identity and all Pixels/Metadata/Selection/Display revisions under its existing mutex before display/constraint validation and mutation. Application resolves the captured ID under its existing membership lock, then invokes that guarded setter. Closed/foreign/stale/invalid requests have no effects. Success advances Display exactlyonce even for equal state; data/history/save identity stay unchanged. Existing unconditional set_display retains behavior.
decisions.active_owner_boundary: This generic API intentionally addresses a captured member even when another owner is active. The eventual Auto controller still requires its separate active-owner/transient-cycle-epoch/job-publication arbitration in the atomic admission lane. Do not infer that the generic primitive alone closes Auto publication.
decisions.verification: Independent Document/Application native tests and required Python tests are implemented/prepared; not executed or qualified by this adoption.

preservation: All original16/80/83/58/28/15 reference membership, physical/workload limits, scalar API names/types, raw histogram semantics and wider product requirements remain unchanged. No commercial or manifest decision changes.
remaining: Finish scalar source holds/focused native/API gates; freeze final Auto record/fallback/settings/cycle contract and implement actual asynchronous shared consumer. One complete installed C++/Python/SDK/both-ImGui exit remains mandatory.
